name: laima
description: A suite of Front-End Tool to develop, showcase, and mock API, powered by webpack.

scripts.start: yarn run base:use-src; DEV_BASE=true NODE_ENV=develop webpack-dashboard -c cyan -t Phaser -- node script/start.js
scripts.before:build: yarn run base:use-lib; yarn run dll:prod;
scripts.build:devtest: yarn run before:build; NODE_ENV=devtest IP=ws://demo.example.com:52014/ws AGENT_ID=0 HOME_URL=https://front-demo.example.com/#/System node script/build.js
scripts.build:qatest: yarn run before:build; NODE_ENV=qatest IP=ws://demo.example.com:52014/ws AGENT_ID=0 HOME_URL=https://front-demo.example.com/#/System node script/build.js
scripts.build:release: yarn run before:build; NODE_ENV=release IP=https://production.example.com:20000/api/entry AGENT_ID=0 HOME_URL=https://www.example.com/#/System node script/build.js
scripts.build:master: yarn run before:build; NODE_ENV=master IP=https://production.example.com:20000/api/entry AGENT_ID=0 HOME_URL=https://www.example.com/#/System node script/build.js
scripts.preview:devtest: yarn run build:devtest; yarn run preview:load-file; yarn run preview:server
scripts.preview:qatest: yarn run build:qatest; yarn run preview:load-file; yarn run preview:server
scripts.preview:release: yarn run build:release; yarn run preview:load-file; yarn run preview:server
scripts.preview:master: yarn run build:master; yarn run preview:load-file; yarn run preview:server
scripts.reinstall: rm -rf node_modules; rm -f yarn.lock; yarn cache clean; yarn
